price.basis: list price of Web Search per call, tiered down by average daily volume; AI Search (/v1/ai-search) is ¥0.060 per call and is not this interface

reachability.note: A mainland-China service: the vendor states its data and results stay in China (数据不出海) and that it serves up to 2000 QPS at about one second. Reachability from outside China is not stated.

bocha-product-document.source: 博查搜索API、排序API 产品服务文档 (杭州博查搜索科技有限公司, PDF of 2025-05-27, mkp-res.hc-cdn.com marketplace attachment 0000000000FE5A9696F)
bocha-product-document.note: States 请求方式 POST, 请求接口 https://api.bochaai.com/v1/web-search, `Authorization: Bearer` with the API key, request fields `query`, `summary`, `freshness`, `count` (至多 50 条), a response compatible with the Bing Search API whose web results carry `name`, `url`, `snippet`, `summary`, `siteName`, and list prices Web Search ¥0.036 and AI Search ¥0.060 per call.

bocha-open-platform.source: 博查 AI 开放平台, open.bochaai.com and open.bochaai.com/overview
bocha-open-platform.note: The portal grants new users a free package of 1,000 calls and links its API documentation and pricing to Feishu wiki pages (bocha-ai.feishu.cn) that require a Feishu login, so the live documentation was not read and the product document above is the reading.

openQuestions: Whether the response wraps the Bing-compatible object in a `data` field is not stated in the product document; the evaluation reads `data.webPages.value` and `webPages.value` alike and records which one answered.
The live pricing page sits behind a Feishu login; the price is the product document's list price.
notes: The vendor states it is DeepSeek's official web-search supplier; that is a statement, not evidence that DeepSeek's server-side search uses it.
